convert_musicgen_melody_checkpoint: convert a Musicgen Melody checkpoint from the original repository to a Hugging Face Transformers model
convert_musicgen_melody_to_local_folder: convert a Musicgen Melody checkpoint and save the model and processor to a local PyTorch dump folder
convert_musicgen_melody_to_hub: convert a Musicgen Melody checkpoint and push the model and processor to a Hugging Face Hub repository
test_musicgen_melody_output: test that a converted Musicgen Melody model produces the same output logits as the original model
build_musicgen_melody_decoder_config: build a Musicgen Melody decoder configuration from a checkpoint name with correct hidden size and layer parameters
